title: 第五章 武道启蒙与截杀第六章 少林
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
江芷薇是一位身穿明黄色衣裙的少女，腰跨长剑，看上去不过十五六岁，但眼神中时不时闪过如紫电般的锋芒，明显是开了眼窍。
“王晋，已开眼窍。”衣着朴素的中年人回道。
“柯碧君，江南人士。”妖娆少妇笑吟吟道：“比不了各位俊杰，我不过是蓄气小成。”
看着就剩下自己，林阳也如实开口：“林阳，我只知道住在朱村，没有修炼过武功，不过有一身天生神力。”
他身上穿着的还是朱村那一身兽皮。
“等完成这一次任务，就可以挑选武功修炼了。”张远山言简意赅。
江芷薇默默地看着几人的自我介绍。没想到六道轮回之主不光会将年轻俊杰拉入轮回空间，就连村民和碌碌无为的中年人也会拉进来，实在让人难以猜测祂是怎么想的。
王晋看了一眼林阳就不太在意，这种没修炼过武功的村民能有什么眼界，所谓的天生神力不过是贻笑大方罢了。
“任务要我们三日内赶到少林，一路上还有朵儿察所派的高手拦截，这一路看来危机四伏。”
有过一次轮回经验的张远山成为队伍的领导者，他带领着众人走向小巷外。
林阳沉默无言的跟着众人。看这本小说的时候还是数年前，具体的剧情已经记不太清，不太清楚张远山这一路上具体遇到过什么，只知道和孟奇那一队人马会和的时候未有死伤，看上去没遇上危机。
经过众人打听，他们所处的是一座名为关河的小镇，距离少林所在的少华山，有一段不短的路程。如果以常人的脚程，三四天都无法抵达少华山。
“我们去买三匹马，日夜赶路。”
江芷薇话如其人，一针见血。
“进入前我准备了百两银子，当做这几天的盘缠足够了。”
众人一路打听，最后来到一家店铺，看外观是租售马匹的地方。
待到张远山拿出银两，杂役牵出来三匹枣红色的马匹，据店家说可以日行六百里。
看着张远山江芷薇等人一个个利索的翻身上马，林阳尴尬的开口了：“我不会骑马。”
“林兄弟你和我同坐一匹马就好，剩下那一匹马就交给王晋王大侠。”张远山理解的点点头，不似江湖人士天南地北的闯荡，骑术是必不可少的一项能力，小山村的村民不会骑马也实属正常。
“多谢！”林阳学着电视剧中看来的样子，抱拳行了一礼。

王晋也不多言，独自骑上一匹马，这正合他意。
江芷薇不知道林阳这次能不能活下来，本着善心提醒一句：“这次任务结束，你要找机会练习一下，以后任务少不了这种情况。”
林阳点点头表示自己明白。他家境虽然不普通，不过也没骑过马。
一众人驾马沿着夯土大道行去，张远山想到林阳不通武艺，也就顺便道：“修炼武功共有几个阶段，正好给你讲一讲，免得结束任务后你自己回去摸索。”
在张远山看来，朱村如果有懂得武学的江湖人，林阳这个二十出头的青年不可能连蓄气都没有达到。既然入了轮回都是队友了，能提携一下对大家都好。
林阳没有拒绝，静静听他讲着。
开脉、蓄气、九窍、外景……
武道大派出身的张远山将修行讲解的明明白白，哪怕实力不可小觑的王晋也受益匪浅，明悟了前路。
这片刻的功夫，一众人就已来到了关河镇镇口，只要再有盏茶时间，他们就会远离关河镇。
咻咻咻！
就在此时，破空声传出，数十根白色羽箭毫无征兆的从密林中射向众人。
张远山眼神收缩，温文尔雅的气质尽去，喝道：“有埋伏！”
抽出腰间长剑精准的将身前的羽箭全部斩断，张远山凝视着丛林深处，有一道人影缓缓的走出。
这是一个五六十岁的老者，身穿深色长袍，身上有一股莫名气质。
“是‘镇河洛’关浩然！”
一个路过的江湖人士惊呼出声。
“没想到他竟然会成为蛮族走狗，叛族离国，真是老糊涂了！”
有人从羽箭的样子认出了袭击者的身份。
“他已入先天之境二十载，是天下有数的绝顶高手，那几人看来要命丧于此。”
“先天之境？也不知道相当于哪个等级的武者，能不能接我一拳。”林阳有点跃跃欲试，不过张远山没有给他这个机会，他开口道：“我对付这个老者，埋伏的甲士箭手交给你们。”

“张师兄，小心！”
江芷薇嘱咐一声不再多言，抽出碧光闪闪的白虹贯日剑就翻身杀向密林深处。
老者没有阻拦，他从对面的那个八卦袍男子身上感觉到了一股威胁，这让他感觉不可思议。对方看上去不及二十，莫非还能踏入先天不成？
看到王晋和柯碧君也紧随江芷薇进了密林，林阳轻呼一口气，也跟了上去。心情复杂。
content_en:
Jiang Zhiwei is a girl wearing a bright yellow dress, with a sword across her waist. She looks like she is only fifteen or sixteen years old, but her eyes flash like purple lightning from time to time, which is obviously her eyesight.
"Wang Jin, your eyes are open." The middle-aged man in simple clothes replied.
"Ke Bijun, a native of Jiangnan." The enchanting young woman smiled and said, "I can't compare to all the heroes. I am just accumulating energy and making small achievements."
Seeing that he was the only one left, Lin Yang spoke truthfully: "Lin Yang, I only know that I live in Zhu Village. I have never practiced martial arts, but I have innate divine power."
He was still wearing Zhu Cun's animal skins.
"After completing this mission, you can choose martial arts to practice." Zhang Yuanshan said concisely and to the point.
Jiang Xiaowei watched silently as several people introduced themselves. Unexpectedly, the Lord of the Six Paths of Reincarnation would not only pull young heroes into the reincarnation space, but also villagers and mediocre middle-aged people. It is really difficult to guess what he thinks.
Wang Jin glanced at Lin Yang and didn't care much. What kind of vision could a villager like this who had never practiced martial arts have? The so-called natural supernatural power was just a joke.
"The mission requires us to get to Shaolin within three days. There are also experts sent by Duoercha to intercept us along the way. It seems that there are dangers along the way."
Zhang Yuanshan, who had a reincarnation experience, became the leader of the team. He led everyone out of the alley.
Lin Yang followed everyone silently. I read this novel a few years ago, and I can't remember the specific plot. I don't know exactly what Zhang Yuanshan encountered along the way. I only know that there were no casualties when he met with Meng Qi's team, and it seemed that there was no crisis.
After everyone inquired, they found out that they were in a small town called Guanhe, which was quite a distance away from Shaohua Mountain where Shaolin was located. If you travel by ordinary people, you will not be able to reach Shaohua Mountain in three or four days.
"Let's buy three horses and drive day and night."
Jiang Zhiwei's words are like a person, and they hit the nail on the head.
"Before entering, I prepared a hundred taels of silver, which is enough to cover the expenses for the past few days."
Everyone inquired all the way, and finally came to a shop, which looked like a place where horses were rented and sold.
When Zhang Yuanshan took out the silver, the servants brought out three maroon horses. According to the store, they could travel six hundred miles a day.
Seeing Zhang Yuanshan, Jiang Zhiwei and others getting on their horses one by one, Lin Yang said awkwardly: "I can't ride a horse."
"Brother Lin, just sit on the same horse with me. The remaining horse will be given to the hero Wang Jinwang." Zhang Yuanshan nodded understandingly. Unlike the people who travel all over the world, riding is an indispensable ability. It is normal for villagers in small mountain villages not to know how to ride a horse.
"Thank you!" Lin Yang imitated the way he looked in the TV series, cupping his fists and saluting.
Wang Jin didn't say much and rode on a horse alone, which was exactly what he wanted.
Jiang Zhiwei didn't know if Lin Yang could survive this time, so she reminded her out of kindness: "After this mission is over, you have to find a chance to practice. This situation will be inevitable in future missions."
Lin Yang nodded to show that he understood. Although his family background is not ordinary, he has never ridden a horse.
A group of people rode horses along the rammed earth road. Zhang Yuanshan thought that Lin Yang was not familiar with martial arts, so he said by the way: "There are several stages in practicing martial arts. I just want to explain them to you, so that you don't have to go back and explore on your own after the mission is over."
In Zhang Yuanshan's view, if there were people in Zhucun who knew martial arts, it would be impossible for Lin Yang, a young man in his early twenties, not to be able to accumulate energy. Since we are all teammates after entering the reincarnation, it would be good for everyone to be able to support them.
Lin Yang did not refuse and listened to him quietly.
Opening pulse, accumulating Qi, nine orifices, exterior scene...
Zhang Yuanshan, who was born in a martial arts school, explained the practice clearly and clearly. Even Wang Jin, whose strength should not be underestimated, benefited a lot and understood the way forward.
In this short time, a group of people have arrived at the entrance of Guanhe Town. As long as there is more tea time, they willStay away from Guanhe Town.
Whoosh!
At this moment, a sound broke through the air, and dozens of white feather arrows shot at everyone from the dense forest without any warning.
Zhang Yuanshan's eyes shrank, his gentle temperament disappeared, and he shouted: "There is an ambush!"
Pulling out the long sword from his waist and accurately cutting off all the arrows in front of him, Zhang Yuanshan stared into the depths of the jungle, and a figure slowly walked out.
This is an old man in his fifties or sixties. He is wearing a dark robe and has an inexplicable aura about him.
"It's 'Zhenheluo' Guan Haoran!"
A passing Jianghu person exclaimed.
"I didn't expect that he would become a lackey of the barbarians, rebel against the tribe and leave the country. He is really an old fool!"
Someone recognized the identity of the attacker from the appearance of the feather arrow.
"He has been in the innate realm for twenty years and is one of the top masters in the world. It seems that those few people are going to die here."
"Innate realm? I don't know what level of warrior you are. Can you take a punch from me?" Lin Yang was a little eager to try, but Zhang Yuanshan did not give him this chance. He said, "I will deal with this old man. I will leave the ambush armored archers to you."
"Senior Brother Zhang, be careful!"
Jiang Zhiwei told her not to say more, drew out the shining white rainbow sun-penetrating sword, and turned over to kill into the depths of the dense forest.
The old man didn't stop him. He felt a threat from the man in Bagua robe opposite, which made him feel incredible. The other party looks less than twenty, could he still be innate?
Seeing Wang Jin and Ke Bijun following Jiang Zhiwei into the dense forest, Lin Yang breathed a sigh of relief and followed them. I have mixed feelings.
